'''Qal''' was a city which during the [[Age of Legends]] fell into the Shadow. It is known that [[sha'je]] duels were popular there.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Qal}}
==Mentiones==
A particular sha'je duel at Qal was mentioned on one of [[Graendal|Graendal's]] and [[Sammael|Sammael's]] secret meetings.{{ref/book|6|6}}
